snippet.title: FeedTheWorld Village Trailer
snippet.description:
Start with a handful of seeds, build a farm that feeds the world.

Feed the World is a single-player 3D farming and automation game where a small forest clearing grows into a thriving food empire.

Plant seasonal crops, raise livestock, hire workers and automate your fields and kitchens.

Balance wages, power and profit as you turn each harvest into bigger possibilities—all towards one extraordinary goal: produce one trillion meals.
